tokens.name: ink-900
tokens.usage: Primary text and dark grounds: titles, headings, table text, title and divider slides. 16.7:1 on paper.

tokens.name: ink-700
tokens.usage: Body copy on paper, surface and ink-100 (11.7:1 on paper); inverse panels in the dark theme.

tokens.name: ink-500
tokens.usage: Secondary text — source lines, captions, footers, axis labels — on paper (5.6:1), surface (5.8:1) and ink-100 (5.2:1); form-control borders.

tokens.name: ink-300
tokens.usage: Hairline rules: table rules, card borders, gridlines, dividers. Decorative only: never text, never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: ink-100
tokens.usage: Quiet fills: slide table header band, chips, progress tracks, code, the Illustrative-data callout.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: The ground: page and slide background. Text on it: ink-900, ink-700, ink-500, accent-600, accent-700, signal.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, tiles, tables and form fields on paper; text on accent-600, navy and RAG fills.

tokens.name: accent-700
tokens.usage: Tracker labels, links, primary-button hover; text on paper (8.0:1) and on accent-100 (7.0:1).

tokens.name: accent-600
tokens.usage: Brand teal, the one thing to look at: key numbers, the focus series, primary buttons, focus ring. 5.8:1 on paper; white on it 6.1:1.

tokens.name: accent-400
tokens.usage: Emphasis on ink-900 grounds (5.2:1): eyebrows and numerals on title and divider slides; the dark-theme accent. Never text on paper (3.2:1).

tokens.name: accent-100
tokens.usage: Teal tint: Key insight ground, highlighted rows, current agenda row. Text on it: ink-900, accent-700 (7.0:1) or accent-600 (5.1:1).

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: Reserved for the binding constraint and critical callouts, at most once per slide or page. 5.0:1 on paper, 5.2:1 on surface; white on it 5.2:1.

tokens.name: signal-100
tokens.usage: Ground of the Critical callout; signal text on it 4.5:1, ink-900 text 17:1.

tokens.name: rag-red
tokens.usage: Status Red only (off track, decision needed), always with the word. White text on it 6.6:1; as text on paper 6.3:1.

tokens.name: rag-amber
tokens.usage: Status Amber only (at risk), always with the word. White text on it 5.4:1; as text on paper 5.2:1.

tokens.name: rag-green
tokens.usage: Status Green only (on track, complete), always with the word. White text on it 5.4:1; as text on paper 5.2:1.

tokens.name: rag-grey
tokens.usage: Status Grey only (not started, planned), always with the word. ink-900 text on it 5.7:1; never white text (3.1:1).

tokens.name: rag-red-100
tokens.usage: High-risk zone (score 12-25) of the risk matrix; markers carry the text.

tokens.name: rag-amber-100
tokens.usage: Medium-risk zone (score 5-11) of the risk matrix; markers carry the text.

tokens.name: rag-green-100
tokens.usage: Low-risk zone (score 1-4) of the risk matrix; markers carry the text.

tokens.name: heat-0
tokens.usage: Maturity level 0, Not started. White number on it (6.6:1).

tokens.name: heat-1
tokens.usage: Maturity level 1, Initial. ink-900 number on it (5.9:1).

tokens.name: heat-2
tokens.usage: Maturity level 2, Defined. ink-900 number on it (10.5:1).

tokens.name: heat-3
tokens.usage: Maturity level 3, Implemented: the target. ink-900 number on it (7.7:1).

tokens.name: heat-4
tokens.usage: Maturity level 4, Assured. White number on it (6.1:1).

tokens.name: viz-1
tokens.usage: Series 1 and the focus series (the client, the base case, the bar the title names). Labels inside: text-on-action.

tokens.name: viz-2
tokens.usage: Series 2, the main comparator (plan, prior period). Labels inside: text-on-action.

tokens.name: viz-3
tokens.usage: Series 3. ink-900 labels inside (5.0:1).

tokens.name: viz-4
tokens.usage: Series 4. ink-900 labels inside (7.6:1).

tokens.name: viz-5
tokens.usage: Series 5. White labels inside (4.7:1).

tokens.name: viz-6
tokens.usage: Series 6, 'other', and the context grey for non-focus bars (3.1:1 on surface). ink-900 labels inside.

tokens.name: bg-page
tokens.usage: Page background on the web. Text on it: text-primary, text-body, text-muted, text-emphasis, text-accent, text-critical, text-danger.

tokens.name: bg-surface
tokens.usage: Cards, tiles, tables, inputs and menus on bg-page; the same text tokens as bg-page.

tokens.name: bg-subtle
tokens.usage: Quiet fills: table header band, chips, progress track, disabled controls, the Illustrative-data callout. Text: text-primary, text-body, text-muted.

tokens.name: bg-emphasis
tokens.usage: Teal tint: Key insight callout, highlighted row, accent tags. Text: text-primary, text-body, text-accent.

tokens.name: bg-inverse
tokens.usage: Inverse panels: the Decision required callout, inverse cards, dark bands. Text: text-on-inverse, accent-on-inverse.

tokens.name: bg-critical
tokens.usage: Critical callout ground (the binding constraint). Text: text-primary, text-body, text-critical.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Titles, headings, labels and table text on bg-page, bg-surface, bg-subtle, bg-emphasis and bg-critical (13:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: text-body
tokens.usage: Running text on bg-page, bg-surface, bg-subtle and bg-emphasis (10:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text (source lines, captions, hints, axis labels) on bg-page, bg-surface and bg-subtle: 5.2:1 or more light, 6.1:1 or more dark.

tokens.name: text-emphasis
tokens.usage: Key numbers and emphasised words on bg-page and bg-surface: 5.8:1 light, 4.7:1 dark. Not on bg-emphasis in the dark theme.

tokens.name: text-accent
tokens.usage: Links, eyebrows and callout labels on bg-page, bg-surface and bg-emphasis: 7.0:1 or more light, 6.5:1 or more dark.

tokens.name: text-critical
tokens.usage: The Critical callout label and the binding-constraint figure on bg-page, bg-surface and bg-critical: 4.5:1 or more light, 6.7:1 or more dark.

tokens.name: text-danger
tokens.usage: Form errors and the word 'Blocked', always with words: 6.3:1 on paper light, 5.6:1 or more dark.

tokens.name: text-on-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on bg-inverse (16.7:1 light, 11.7:1 dark).

tokens.name: accent-on-inverse
tokens.usage: Labels and numbers on bg-inverse: 5.2:1 light, 6.9:1 dark.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Primary button fill, selected scale segment, checked box, progress fill, current-page rule.

tokens.name: action-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of action fills.

tokens.name: text-on-action
tokens.usage: Text and icons on action and viz-1/viz-2 fills: 6.1:1 light, 5.2:1 dark.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines: table rules, card borders, dividers, gridlines. Decorative only.

tokens.name: rule-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, secondary buttons, scale segments, checkboxes): 3:1 or more on every ground in both themes.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus outline, 2px solid with a 2px offset: 5.8:1 on paper, 5.2:1 on ink-900.

groups.name: Slides (1920 x 1080)

styles.usage: Paragraph heads and card titles.

styles.name: body-small

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Trackers above headings, card and KPI labels: uppercase (bundle.css adds it), tracked.

styles.name: exhibit-title

styles.usage: Exhibit caption lines in documents.

styles.name: source-line
styles.usage: Source lines, notes, footnotes and footers.

styles.name: kpi-value

styles.name: hero-number

groups.name: IDs and code

styles.name: id
styles.usage: Identifiers in text, tables and labels.

styles.name: slide-id
styles.usage: Identifiers on slides.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap; between a dot and its word.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside compact controls; between tags; heading to its first paragraph.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell padding; between related rows; slide bar-chart row gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Callout and compact card padding; between form fields; slide footer rule to text.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card and KPI tile padding; grid gutters on the web; slide column-head gap.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between groups on the web; slide card padding and gaps.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Before a document section; slide title-to-body gap.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page top padding; slide tracker and footer offsets from the edge.

tokens.name: space-9

tokens.name: space-10

radius.note: Crisp, not bubbly: 2/4/6. Round means status.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags, chart bars, heat cells, risk cells, Gantt bars.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, scale strips, callouts, KPI tiles, slide panels.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Web cards: the largest container radius in the system.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status only: RAG pills and dots, Harvey balls, risk markers.

tokens.name: border-hairline

tokens.name: icon-stroke
